title: T-15B Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Torc T-15B Anthracite is tuned for city streets, daily work runs, and weekend joyrides. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1422g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~88 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Bluetooth-integrated full face with 3D speakers and 10-hour battery.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; may require sizing up for intermediate oval or round heads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Torc T-15B Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Torc T-15B Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Torc T-15B Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Torc's Full Face lineup, the T-15B Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Torc T-15B Anthracite represents Torc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Torc T-15B Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
